aggregation: Each final controller ledger is cumulative; only the highest sequence per session is counted. Each JSON proxy log line is one event; its cumulative count field is not summed. Browser and proxy totals describe separate observation layers and are not added.
limits: Blocked analytics, socket, and browser background attempts are reported separately from successful read forwarding. No claim that zero attempts occurred.

One controller started before executor transport loss has no final ledger or captured images. The dedicated Chrome was independently observed at about:blank before recovery; all retained proxy logs and every successful source capture are covered. No exact request-attempt count is claimed for that interrupted controller.
